notes: Pedestrian and bicycle counts are not available: the delivered CRIS exports have no pedestrian or bicycle field.
run_off_road counts all single-vehicle crashes (CRIS manner of collision 'one motor vehicle'); it is a proxy, not a roadway-departure flag.
head_on = opposite direction, both going straight; left_turn_opposing = opposite direction with a left-turning vehicle (not head-on).
night = dark lighted, dark not lighted or dark unknown lighting; wet = wet or standing water.

Check treatment prerequisites, geometry, traffic volumes, and existing equipment: Three-/four-leg stop-controlled intersections; 2-4 lanes; major AADT 641-41731; minor AADT 102-8436. Package includes paired warning/STOP signs, reflective posts, and renewed stop/yield bars and other markings.
Complete source verification; current status: evidence_checked_indexed

evidence.study_reference: Le et al., 2017; Safety Effects of Low-Cost Systemic Safety Improvements at Signalized and Stop-Controlled Intersections
evidence.limitations: Empirical Bayes before-after, South Carolina; 434 sites. Applies to the package, not one sign or marking by itself.

reasons: Area setting is compatible with the recorded study setting.
Study covers all crash types combined.
review_needed: Aggregate CMF does not establish a reduction for the requested crash subtype alone.

Check treatment prerequisites, geometry, traffic volumes, and existing equipment: Four-leg stop-controlled roadway intersection on two-lane roads. Major-road ADT 250-42520; minor-road ADT 90-13270. Standard and actuated beacons were studied; confirm the chosen installation.
Complete source verification; current status: evidence_checked_indexed

evidence.study_reference: Srinivasan et al., 2008; Safety Evaluation of Flashing Beacons at Stop Controlled Intersections
evidence.limitations: Empirical Bayes study. Adjusted SE 0.04. HSM explicitly recommends caution because uncertainty includes no effect or an increase. Aggregate scope; not an angle-only estimate. Not an RRFB pedestrian-crossing treatment.

sections.crash_profile: From {{window_start}} to {{window_end}}, {{total_3y}} crashes occurred at this unsignalized intersection, with {{ka_3y}} fatal or suspected serious injury crashes. The dominant crash type was angle ({{angle_3y}}), with some rear-end, run-off-road, and left-turn-opposing collisions. Pedestrian and bicycle counts are not available.
sections.why_flagged: Flagged for high fatal or serious injury crash rate ({{fsi_rate}} per mile), high traffic exposure ({{aadt}} vehicles/day), and inclusion in the High Injury Network. The intersection is unsignalized, has multiple legs, and is located on a state route.

countermeasures.rationale: The systemic signing and marking improvement package is supported by broader evidence for all crash types and severities, with a CMF from {{cmf:8867}}. This entry is not a direct crash-type match and requires engineering review, including confirmation of intersection geometry and existing equipment.

Flashing beacons at stop-controlled intersections are supported by broader evidence for all crash types and severities, with a CMF from {{cmf:446}}. This entry is not a direct crash-type match and requires engineering review to confirm geometry, traffic volumes, and beacon installation type.

sections.benefit_cost: A numerical benefit could not be computed for either countermeasure. The CMF evidence audit does not approve a library entry for benefit calculation, and the severity scopes do not match fatal or serious injury crashes only. Planning-level unit costs and service lives are also unavailable.
sections.next_steps: Conduct engineering review to confirm intersection geometry, traffic volumes, and existing signing and marking conditions. Assess prerequisites for both countermeasures, including suitability for systemic signing upgrades and flashing beacons. Coordinate with TxDOT for jurisdictional approval and equipment standards.
